product_overview: DK Fitt Base Clinic is a web application for nutrition clinic teams to manage patient follow-up, nutrition plans, foods, recipes, alerts, appointments, and administrative activity from a single interface. It supports nutritionists in daily clinical workflows and gives administrators control over users and system oversight.
core_goals: Sign in securely and access the correct experience by role
Review nutritionist dashboard metrics, patient trends, and alerts
Manage patients and open detailed clinical records
Create, review, activate, suspend, and update nutrition plans
Browse, create, edit, and build foods and recipes
Monitor patient follow-up, alerts, and appointments
Update personal nutritionist profile information and password
Manage users and review system activity as an administrator

features.name: Authentication and role-based access
features.description: Users sign in with institutional credentials, are routed to the correct area by role, and can sign out from the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the nutritionist dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the administrator dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See a validation or sign-in error
Use logout from the app -> Return to the login screen

features.name: Mandatory password change
features.description: Accounts with a temporary password must set a new password before accessing protected areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /cambiar-contrasena -> Enter current password -> Enter a new password that meets strength rules -> Confirm the new password -> Submit the password change -> Return to the login screen
Navigate to /cambiar-contrasena -> Enter a new password that does not meet strength rules -> Submit the password change -> See validation feedback

features.name: Nutritionist dashboard
features.description: Nutritionists review weekly clinical indicators, compare weight and calorie trends, inspect patient summaries, and check unread alerts.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View dashboard KPIs -> Select up to three patients for the weight chart -> Inspect planned versus consumed calories -> Review the patient summary table -> Review unread alerts
Navigate to / -> View dashboard KPIs -> Open a patient from the summary table -> See the patient detail area

features.name: Patient list and clinical record
features.description: Nutritionists browse patients, search the list, and open each patient’s clinical record with its clinical and operational tabs.
user_flows: Navigate to /pacientes -> Search or scan the patient list -> Open a patient detail page -> Review the summary tab -> Switch between clinical record tabs -> Review profile, evaluations, plans, intake, appointments, follow-up, and alerts
Navigate to /pacientes -> Search for a patient -> Open the matching patient detail page -> Review the patient record

features.name: Nutrition plans
features.description: Nutritionists select a patient with plan data, review weekly plan structure, and manage plan status or daily menu changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /planes -> Select a patient with nutrition plan data -> Open the plan detail page -> Review the weekly plan grid -> Activate, suspend, or reactivate the plan
Navigate to /planes -> Select a patient with nutrition plan data -> Open the plan detail page -> Replace a daily menu dish
Navigate to /planes -> Select a patient with nutrition plan data -> Open the plan detail page -> Lock or unlock a plan module

features.name: Food and recipe management
features.description: Nutritionists manage detailed foods, browse recipes, generate generic recipes, and build dishes from ingredients.
user_flows: Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch between the foods, recipes, and constructor tabs -> Create a detailed food entry -> Review the updated foods list
Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch between the foods, recipes, and constructor tabs -> Edit a detailed food entry -> Review the updated data
Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch between the foods, recipes, and constructor tabs -> Delete a detailed food entry -> See the item removed from the list
Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch to the recipes tab -> Browse recipes -> Open a recipe detail
Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch to the constructor tab -> Select foods to build a dish -> Save the dish
Navigate to /alimentos -> Switch to the recipes tab -> Generate a generic recipe -> Review the generated recipe

features.name: Follow-up
features.description: Nutritionists review patient meal and exercise follow-up, including adherence status and tracking details.
user_flows: Navigate to /seguimiento -> View the patient follow-up list -> Select a patient -> Review meals and exercises -> Inspect adherence-related status
Navigate to /seguimiento -> View the patient follow-up list -> Select another patient -> Compare follow-up status

features.name: Alerts
features.description: Nutritionists review clinical alerts, inspect details, and mark alerts as reviewed.
user_flows: Navigate to /alertas -> Open the alerts inbox -> Review alert details -> Mark an alert as reviewed
Navigate to /alertas -> Open the alerts inbox -> Filter alerts by patient or type -> Review the filtered results -> Open an alert detail

features.name: Appointments
features.description: Nutritionists view, create, edit, and update the status of appointments.
user_flows: Navigate to /citas -> View the appointment list -> Filter or inspect appointments -> Create a new appointment -> Review the updated calendar or list
Navigate to /citas -> View the appointment list -> Open an existing appointment -> Edit the appointment details -> Review the updated appointment
Navigate to /citas -> View the appointment list -> Open an appointment -> Change its status -> Review the updated status

features.name: Nutritionist profile
features.description: Nutritionists review their own profile data and update their password.
user_flows: Navigate to /mi-perfil -> Open the profile page -> Review personal and professional data
Navigate to /mi-perfil -> Open the profile page -> Start a password change -> Enter the required password data -> Submit the update -> Return to the profile view

features.name: Administrator dashboard
features.description: Administrators review high-level system indicators and navigate to user management or activity history.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View administrator dashboard cards and charts -> Review system indicators
Navigate to /admin -> View administrator dashboard cards and charts -> Navigate to user management
Navigate to /admin -> View administrator dashboard cards and charts -> Navigate to activity history

features.name: Administrator user management
features.description: Administrators search and filter users, create nutritionists, edit user data, toggle status, and reset temporary passwords.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Search or filter users -> Open the create nutritionist form -> Fill in nutritionist data -> Submit the form -> See the new user appear in the list
Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Search or filter users -> Open an existing user -> Edit the user data -> Submit the changes -> See the updated user record
Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Search or filter users -> Select a user -> Activate or deactivate the account -> See the status change reflected
Navigate to /admin/usuarios -> Search or filter users -> Select a user -> Reset the temporary password -> Review the newly generated password

features.name: Administrator activity history
features.description: Administrators review and filter the system activity log.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/historial -> Review recent administrative actions -> Search or filter the history records
Navigate to /admin/historial -> Review the activity log -> Open a different filter -> See the list update

Food database, recipes and recipe constructor tabs
Patient follow-up overview for meals and exercises

known_limitations.issue: TestSprite is connected to a Vite dev server on port 8080, so generated frontend execution may be limited to high-priority tests for stability.
known_limitations.impact: Full concurrent coverage may require running a production build with vite preview on the configured port.

known_limitations.issue: Several modules intentionally try fallback endpoints for the same resource.
known_limitations.impact: Tests may see successful behavior through alternate endpoint paths depending on backend availability.
